pr_title: UX1-475 - Implement custom fields table structure with data fetched from cm-api

comments.body: Thank you for catching this and fixing it :D

Can consider checking `title === "Email address" || title === "Name"` to be more robust and consistent with code in c#. 
Dunno if it's overkill though. 
https://git.campmon.com/Freshview/createsend.com/blob/f17599d8641df6da162b5f30923643cd6b4c310b/app/CampMon.CmAPI/Endpoints/CustomFields/CustomFieldsValidationService.cs#L78-L81

Something to consider: 
Since this can never realistically happen in practice (email and name are always gonna be there), we can repurpose this to render a generic error message instead for when the fetch fails? 

Could be annoyingly difficult or not needed since fetch is handled in the parent component.

Avoid using single character variables. 
Also can move these helper functions and string constants up and outside of the component code so they don't get recreated on every rerender.

Unsure so ignore me if I'm wrong: 
Do we need this here since it's also imported in the parent component file `CustomFields.tsx`?
If you type the function return `Promise<CmCustomField[]>` you can avoid the `as` hard cast here.
